halt_guidance.blocker: SCRB-seq/mcSCRB-seq needs a plate/well barcode manifest and protocol-specific barcode/UMI positions before cell-level quantification.
required_inputs: Well barcode list and well-to-sample mapping
Confirmed protocol variant, barcode/UMI coordinates, cDNA read, and strandedness
next_steps: Identify the SCRB-seq protocol variant and recover its well barcode manifest.
Check read orientation and barcode/UMI positions against representative FASTQs.
Run zUMIs or an explicitly configured STARsolo workflow and verify expected well recovery.

recommended_workflows.name: zUMIs
recommended_workflows.role: Protocol-configurable UMI parsing and gene counting

halt_guidance.resume: After the well manifest and geometry are verified, an explicit SCRB-seq STARsolo target can be prepared.
